# AGENTS.md

Instructions for AI coding agents live in [CLAUDE.md](../../CLAUDE.md). Read it before making
a change. This file is a pointer for tools that look here, not a second copy.

`task --list` is the interface. Verify with `task test:run` and `task validate`; run a real
analysis with `task analyse FILE=<path>`. Never run `task uploads:clean`, never delete
`uploads/`, never push.
